Name: New Caroline Portrait by Bucket
Author: MrsTNT69
Description:
I was never a big fan of strictly frontal portraits, so I gave Caroline a subtle pose adjustment — leaning into that angled look many other NPCs have.
This version shifts her portrait toward a softer profile while keeping her recognizable feel, but with a sharper, more mature appearance to better match the direction I wanted for her. And yes —[b] breasts exist in the real world[/b], so I added them :3

Maybe in the future I can add more variants or outfits for them. For now, [i][b]Enjoy[/b][/i]!!
